points.title: Silence
points.titleSub: (An hour a day with nothing playing)

body.text: No headphones on the walk and no show during dinner. The first three days feel long. After that the noise is what feels strange.
It exists to check that the batch endpoint sends ten decks to TikTok in one call. Delete it when that is confirmed.
